_what_this_is: The measured ladder of virtual-screening methods: what each one is worth, what its own
run-to-run noise is, and whether it survives transfer to a new target. Every number here
was measured by us and carries a provenance pointer.
It is BOTH the proprietary knowledge asset and the thing the generation gate consults.
One artifact, so the gate can never drift from the evidence.
A method may only be entered once its floor is MEASURED. An unmeasured floor of 0
silently asserts perfect reproducibility, which is the error that produced the JCIM

vina_exh4_mpro.note: Measured by varying ONLY --seed. Two single runs differ by sqrt(2) x this. Measured on 755 compounds -- see _floors_are_panel_specific before charging it against a claim computed on a different panel.

vina_exh32.note: MEASURED, replacing the earlier MEASURING placeholder. Per-ligand scores are far more reproducible than at exh=4 (0.035 vs 0.096 eV; median rank span 10 vs 70), yet the AUROC sd is similar -- because AUROC sd is set by panel size, not by per-ligand precision.
vina_exh32.vs_exh4: Matched on 339 compounds and the same 6 seeds: exh=4 sd 0.00812, exh=32 0.00626, ratio 0.77, Pitman-Morgan paired p=0.624. NOT distinguishable at n=6. Substituting the exh=4 floor is conservative in DIRECTION only; that is not established. Paired rather than F-test because the arms share seeds. analysis/seed_floor/floor_exh4_vs_exh32.py

gnina_rescore.note: 745/745 poses bitwise identical across repeat runs -- contributes NO run-to-run noise. A floor of 0 is entered here because it was MEASURED, not assumed.
gnina_rescore.caveat: Seed 42 vs 43 also gives 745/745 identical. Determinism is implementation-level (--score_only does no stochastic search); the worker --seed does nothing. Do NOT infer that seeding DiffDock or Boltz-2 makes them reproducible.

boltz2.auroc_floor_metric: residual AUROC (the quantity the harness margin uses), 95% upper bound
boltz2.supersedes: 0.0201, which was FLOOR_SCORING from analysis/pose_ensemble -- the VINA scoring floor, borrowed for Boltz-2 by PREREGISTRATION_TRANSFER.md. It was about 4x too large, i.e. wrong in the direction that made a negative verdict look stronger than the evidence supported.
boltz2.note: 0 of 24 duplicated-ligand pairs identical to 5 dp; max difference 0.0905 in binding probability. Unlike gnina (745/745 bitwise identical) Boltz-2 has no zero floor. Noise is heteroscedastic, r=+0.80 with distance from the 0/1 bounds.
boltz2.caveat: Derived by propagating per-compound noise measured on 24 pairs through the real 885-compound panel, not by full-panel replication. The FXa decision turns on the third decimal, so 100 pairs (~$5) would tighten it materially.

_floors_are_panel_specific: An AUROC noise floor is a property of (method, protocol, PANEL SIZE) -- not of the method
alone. AUROC variance scales as 1/n_compounds, verified rather than assumed: the stage-1
exh=4 sd of 0.00497 on 755 compounds predicts 0.00742 on a 339-compound panel, and the
matched re-measurement gave 0.00767 -- a ratio of 1.034, from a prediction using data the
So a floor measured on 755 compounds is ~1.5x too SMALL to charge against a claim computed
on 339, and using it there would wave through effects that are really inside the noise.
Re-scale by sqrt(n_measured / n_claim), or measure the floor on the claim's own panel.
Every entry here carries panel_n_compounds for that reason.

residual_beyond_properties._metric: AUROC after out-of-fold descriptor residualisation, against a MEASURED pure-descriptor null (not 0.5)

boltz2_fxa.note: Does NOT clear its own 0.0201 floor.

boltz2_aldh1.note: Clears its floor, unlike FXa. In-target AUROC only 0.5629.

inadmissible.PDL1: descriptor baseline 0.874 > 0.80 -- properties already separate this panel (79% active, inactives 127 Da heavier), so nothing measured on it can show a method exceeds properties

vina.correction: Previously recorded as NOT_BEYOND_PROPERTIES on 3 targets. PD-L1 was inadmissible and should never have counted; with it removed the harness has 2 targets and refuses a transferability verdict.

boltz2.decided_by: harness.py rule fixed before the ALDH1 numbers existed
boltz2.CAVEAT_floor_is_inherited: RESOLVED 21 Sep 2026. The floor is now MEASURED for Boltz-2 itself: 0.00592 (analysis/boltz2/FLOOR_RESULT.md), replacing the borrowed Vina 0.0201. The verdict is UNCHANGED -- FXa's +0.0042 still fails -- but by a whisker rather than by 5x, so the confidence behind NOT_BEYOND_PROPERTIES is much lower than the original numbers implied.
boltz2.note: The target where Boltz-2 is WEAKEST in-target (ALDH1, 0.5629) is its BEST donor, transferring usably to both proteases, and its hardest recipient. Consistent with ALDH1 having the lowest descriptor baseline (0.5698): least property signal to lean on, so what is learned there travels.

interventions._metric: delta AUROC, charged for run-to-run noise (analysis/seed_floor/RESULT.md)

eightfold_search_effort.note: Re-measured PAIRED within seed, the estimator fixed before the data existed. t-test p=0.339, Wilcoxon p=0.5625; both reported because the script computes both and picking afterwards is circular. The manuscript's single unpaired +0.0185 lies outside this CI, though it was computed on a different panel so that comparison is indicative of magnitude rather than a test. Perturbs the ranking LESS than a reseed does (Spearman 0.9593 vs 0.9551).

gate_rules._docking_gap_rationale: Median per-ligand score sd across 10 seeds of an unchanged protocol. A quoted gap below this is within the noise of re-running the same calculation.
gate_rules._docking_alone_rationale: On both ADMISSIBLE targets Vina's residual sits at or below a measured pure-descriptor null (Factor Xa -0.0128, Mpro +0.0171 against a 0.00817 floor), and the manuscript's residual table puts six docking scores in 0.494-0.573. The harness verdict is formally INSUFFICIENT at 2 targets -- the rule rests on the per-target residuals and the independent AcrB decoy control, NOT on a transferability verdict we do not have.
